baseline.method: Reproduced official SPD signed standard-major-axis fit, five natural measured specimens

definition: Maximum absolute field-strength discrepancy in microtesla across all five named specimens; no alignment, rescaling or masking.
reference_type: independent upstream standard-method result; no declared physical ground truth
rationale: Nonzero numerical reproduction tolerance fixed before extraction, much larger than float64 parity errors; does not imply microtesla physical accuracy. Historical expected fields are diagnostic context only.
